name: jcode
description: Runs a Rust coding-agent harness in the terminal with swarms of collaborating agents, semantic memory, logins for major model subscriptions, and a TypeScript SDK for driving sessions.

skills.name: Agent Swarms
skills.description: Coordinates two or more agents in the same repo through a shared server, and lets an agent spawn its own teammates with the swarm tool.

skills.name: Semantic Memory
skills.description: Embeds each turn, retrieves related entries from a memory graph by cosine similarity, and gives agents explicit memory and session search tools.

skills.name: TypeScript SDK
skills.description: Drives jcode sessions from your program with @1jehuang/jcode-sdk, streaming replies and tool calls and handling permission prompts.

skills.name: Provider Logins
skills.description: Signs in to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, GitHub Copilot and other providers with jcode login, or adds any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
